order: Close out the two majors and the records item from the R0-EX8 verdict. Creation-time identity capture must fail closed, so have createCheckout resolve the checkout's canonical path itself and refuse the checkout, cleaning up the registration it just made, whenever that resolution fails; the lexical fallback then serves only already-gone swept paths, and the poisoned-realpath case gets pinned by a regression test. Replace the fixed sleeps in both review-lane kill branches, the SIGTERM branch and the SIGKILL branch, with a poll of git's own worktree registration lock, so each signal lands after the checkout has finished registering. A slow checkout stays locked past any fixed delay, and a kill arriving mid-registration leaves a locked worktree a single force cannot reclaim. Correct the records so the nine-of-nine green claim names the PR-head run and states the superseded run's true outcome, including the flake that fired. Record the verdict verbatim and hold the tranche at REVISE.
claims: All four items are done. createCheckout now resolves the canonical path itself and refuses the checkout on failure, with the poisoned-realpath regression pinned in the verifier suite. Both kill branches, SIGTERM and SIGKILL, poll the new waitWorktreesUnlocked helper in place of the old fixed sleep, and each asserts that the checkout finished registering before its signal goes out, so both new lock-condition checks pass. The dispositions record now names the PR-head run and the superseded run's true outcome. Suites ran green at verifier 99, review-lane 116 twice over, router 135 and registry 31.
